title: Declaration Base Information Package
description: Details related to any statement or action, in any form prescribed or accepted by the Government Agency, giving information or particulars required by the Governmental Agency.

acceptanceDateTime.description: Date and time of acceptance of a document in accordance with governmental legislation.

cancellationDateTime.description: Date and time when the document/message was cancelled.

effectiveDateTime.description: Date and time of effectiveness of the document (e.g. license, visa, permit, certificate, bond).

expirationDateTime.description: Date and time of expiration of the document (e.g. license, visa, permit, certificate, bond).

validityDurationQuantity.description: Quantity specifying the requested validity expressed in days (i.e., it will be a number of days indicated in the data field and not a period expressed as "from ? until ?").

goodsItemQuantity.description: Quantity specifying the total number of goods items within a document.

invoiceAmount.description: Amount indicating the total of all invoice amounts in a single declaration.

loadingListQuantity.description: Quantity specifying the number of loading lists, manifests or similar documents.

jurisdictionDateTime.description: Date and time of landing, bringing, or introduction at any place subject to a country's jurisdiction whether or not such landing, bringing, or introduction constitutes an import (e.g. the date of import used in US tariff laws).

totalPackageQuantity.description: Quantity specifying the total number of packages of the entire document (e.g. declaration/consignment).

sealsAffixedQuantity.description: Quantity specifying the number of seals affixed.

transportMovementCode.description: Code specifying a particular transport movement.

splitConsignmentQuantity.description: Quantity specifying the total number of split-consignments for a transit declaration.

safetySecurityCode.description: Code specifying whether the declaration is combined with safety and security related declarations.
